basic_details.job_title: KSRTC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Public Relations Officer, Executive Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) is hiring a Public Relations Officer and an Executive Engineer (Civil) on contract. There is 1 vacancy in each post. The Public Relations Officer gets a maximum consolidated pay of Rs. 45,000 per month and needs a degree plus a PG Degree or Diploma in Public Relations, Mass Communication or Journalism. The Executive Engineer (Civil) post is for retired Executive Engineers and above from PWD or CPWD with a B Tech in Civil Engineering. Applications are accepted online only, on the Centre for Management Development (CMD) website, www.cmd.kerala.gov.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria may apply in ONLINE mode only. No application submitted at the office of KSRTC/CMD, online or offline, will be entertained other than through the online portal.
Visit the website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram: www.cmd.kerala.gov.in. The online application link opens on 24 October 2026.
Fill in the prescribed application form using a valid personal email ID and mobile number. Keep both active until the recruitment process is complete, because CMD may send call letters by email.
Upload your updated CV, a passport size photograph taken within six months, your signature and copies of the certificates that prove your qualification and experience.
Submit the application by 6 November 2026, 05.00 PM.
Check for a confirmation message or email from the portal, and save or note down the application reference number for future correspondence.
For problems with the online form, contact the HELP DESK at 0471 2320101 ext: 216, between 10 A.M. and 5:30 P.M. on working days (Monday to Friday).
Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), in JPEG or PDF format
Passport size photograph taken within six months, in JPEG format, less than 200 kB
Signature in JPEG format, less than 50 kB
Copies of certificates proving qualification and experience, in JPEG or PDF format; each attachment must not exceed 3 MB
Self-attested copies of all the documents needed to prove identity, age, qualifications and experience
Equivalency certificate from the competent authority, for applicants with an equivalent qualification
For current experience: an AFFIDAVIT giving the employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities
Copies of appointment letters, salary certificates, pay slips and similar papers are not accepted in place of a work experience certificate.
important_instructions: The Public Relations Officer will be posted in Thiruvananthapuram and has to travel extensively throughout the State. Executive Engineer (Civil) candidates must be willing to be posted anywhere in Kerala and to travel extensively within the State and outside. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Applications without complete data, with wrong or unnecessary documents, or with a blurred or illegible photograph or signature will be rejected. If the details in the online form do not match the original documents, the candidature will be rejected. If any information is found to be false at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated without notice. CMD may ask for additional documents to support the qualification, experience or other eligibility requirements. The Competent Authority may debar a candidate for any malpractice, including a fraudulent claim of any benefit, relaxation or concession. KSRTC/CMD reserves the right to fill or not fill the posts without giving any reason. KSRTC may modify or cancel the notification, revise the number of posts, or stop the recruitment process at any time.

content_sections.heading: About KSRTC
content_sections.text: Kerala State Road Transport Corporation is a statutory corporation established under the provisions of the Road Transport Corporations Act, 1950. For this recruitment, the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, receives the applications and handles parts of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India and should be able to write and speak English and Malayalam fluently. Work experience and the upper age limit are counted as on 01.10.2026. Qualification: B Tech in Civil Engineering degree OR Equivalent qualification recognized by University of Kerala. Experience: Retired Executive Engineers above from PWD / CPWD engaged in the design and construction of major buildings. Applicants should have a minimum of 10 years experience in the construction of buildings. Upper age limit: 65 years as on 01.10.2026. The conditions of experience and age limit may be relaxed in the case of exceptionally qualified candidates. Preferred, and given weightage in selection: familiarity with Government procedure, designing of multi-storeyed buildings, experience in Auto Cad, Excel Software, Project Management Software, preparation of estimates using PRICE Software, recording in Measurement Book/e Measurement book, e-tendering, preparing bills and supervision of PMC related works. The qualification must be from a recognised University/Institute. Applicants with a qualification equivalent to a prescribed one must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority. Without it, the candidature will not be considered. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification.

The contract is initially for a period of one (1) year, extendable on the basis of performance. Only candidates who are willing to work beyond office hours should apply.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinised based on the details the candidate provides, and a list of candidates eligible for the further selection process will be prepared. Selection will be based on an interview of the shortlisted candidates. KSRTC/CMD reserves the right to add another selection process if required. KSRTC/CMD may shortlist only a limited number of candidates, based on relevancy of experience, quality of academic achievements and overall suitability for the position. CMD may decide the selection process based on specific requirements. It may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, a skill test/proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the selection process, by email, SMS or phone call. CMD may send the intimation to download call letters to the registered e-mail ID. Admission to any stage of the recruitment is provisional. Applications and credentials will be scrutinised in detail before the interview/appointment, and any discrepancy will lead to rejection. CMD reserves the rules for the cut-off marks in all stages of the recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies under KSRTC Recruitment 2026: 1 for Public Relations Officer and 1 for Executive Engineer (Civil). Both posts are on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 6 November 2026, 05.00 PM. The application link on the CMD website opens on 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the KSRTC Public Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a degree in any discipline from a UGC recognized university or National institute under the GoI. They also need a recognized PG Degree/Diploma in Public Relation, Mass communications, Journalism, Public Relations and advertising, or Public relations and visual media communication. Proficiency in Malayalam and English and experience in Print media approved by RNI List are also required.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the KSRTC Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Retired Executive Engineers and above from PWD / CPWD who were engaged in the design and construction of major buildings may apply. They need a B Tech in Civil Engineering degree, or an equivalent qualification recognized by University of Kerala, and at least 10 years' experience in the construction of buildings.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01.10.2026, the upper age limit is 60 years for Public Relations Officer and 65 years for Executive Engineer (Civil). For Executive Engineer (Civil), the age limit and experience conditions may be relaxed for exceptionally qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the KSRTC posts?
faq.answer: The Public Relations Officer gets a maximum consolidated pay of Rs. 45,000/- per month. For the Executive Engineer (Civil), remuneration for those who retired from Govt. service is as per re-employment basis.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only, by filling the prescribed form on the CMD website (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in). Upload your CV, photograph, signature and certificates there. KSRTC/CMD will not entertain applications submitted at its office.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for KSRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and eligible candidates are shortlisted. Selection is then based on an interview of the shortlisted candidates. KSRTC/CMD may add another selection process if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is the KSRTC job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are on contract basis, initially for one (1) year. The Executive Engineer (Civil) contract is extendable on the basis of performance.

faq.question: Q10. Will KSRTC pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
